# GitHub configuration

Issues and pull requests belong to [juanpprieto/fgj](https://github.com/juanpprieto/fgj),
including contributions made from older checkouts with Forgejo remotes.
See the [agent working agreement](../AGENTS.md) and [contributor guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

This directory owns the public repository's [workflows](workflows/README.md).

These files do not create a repository or configure its server-side permissions.
The workflows do not grant release authority or configure server-side permissions.
Maintainers must verify repository settings before they approve untrusted workflow changes.
